.remote — a private emote

.remote <name> <text> is to .emote what .tell is to speech: an action
delivered to one person. Wren sees: >> Corvid waves. You see your
own line tagged with where it went: >> (to Wren) Corvid waves. .remote
alone continues with your last correspondent if any. Otherwise
everything else behaves like .tell. Shortcut: .r <
